items.name: Vårerteknapp
items.observations: Original botanical watercolor illustration of an upright perennial spring pea, with paired pointed pinnate leaflets lacking tendrils, broad stipules at stem nodes, racemes of red-purple pea-shaped flowers turning blue-violet as they age, thin pods and roots. Verified against a black background.
items.limitations: Educational stylized botanical illustration, not a photograph or herbarium specimen. Fine venation, exact stipule shapes, flower positions and root architecture are simplified; image alone is not a definitive identification key.
